title: A busy Saturday
instructions: Tom geçen cumartesi yaptıklarını sırayla anlatıyor. Olayların sırasına dikkat et.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Last Saturday was a very busy day for me.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: In the morning, I cleaned my room and washed my car.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: At twelve, I met my friend Ben for lunch at an Italian restaurant.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: After lunch, we went to a football match. Our team lost, two to one.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: In the evening, I was very tired, so I stayed at home.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: I ordered a pizza and watched a film. I fell asleep before the end!

questions.prompt: What did Tom do in the morning?
options: He cleaned his room and washed his car.
questions.feedback: Sabah odasını temizledi ve arabasını yıkadı.
questions.evidence: In the morning, I cleaned my room and washed my car.

questions.prompt: What was the result of the match?
questions.evidence: Our team lost, two to one.

questions.feedback: Çok yorgundu, evde kaldı (stayed at home), pizza söyledi.
